silhouette.reason: Tapered beard with locks and a full hair mass read as a dwarf in FRONT and 3/4; in SIDE a moustache strand sticks out from the face like a straw.
fixes: curl the moustache ends down into the beard so no strand pokes forward in SIDE

proportions.reason: The face reads young and smooth for a dwarf: no deep nasolabial folds, no lid sag, a narrow nose.
fixes: stronger age: deeper nasolabial folds and lid sag as displacement; broader nose

materials.reason: Skin reads as matte plastic with a uniform pink-beige and dark spot decals; no subsurface warmth at ears/nose, no wet eyes or lips. The beard and hair cards read as hair with some value variation.
fixes: skin strip with sheen/lower roughness on the T-zone, red warmth at ears, nose and lips; glossy eyes and wet lip line
hair strip with anisotropic sheen and darker roots, per-card value variation

detail.reason: Beard and hair cards with varied locks; the face has no pores or wrinkles at the hero distance.
fixes: LOD0 wrinkle/pore displacement on the face driven by age

wear.reason: Freckle/blemish dots and red cheeks; no scars, no weathered skin.
fixes: one seeded scar across the brow and wind-reddened, weathered skin

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 is a distance-field re-mesh: the face breaks into flat patches of different tone and the features smear. The beard holds as a mass.
fixes: LOD2 from an authored coarse topology (decimated quad base mesh) instead of the distance-field re-mesh, keeping vertex colour smooth

technical.reason: QA clean; 77k / 15k / 4k triangles over 4 draws; heavy for a bust.
fixes: coarser beard cell at LOD1 and fewer beard cards at LOD0
